item.title: Israeli Diplomat Warns of Diminishing US Support
item.description: Israeli Consul General in New York Ofir Akunis said shifting U.S. political attitudes present a long-term challenge to the bilateral relationship.

item.title: Virginia Democrat's Past Support for Progressive Prosecutors Revealed
item.description: Shannon Taylor's record as Henrico County prosecutor contrasts with her tough-on-crime campaign stance in the race for Virginia's 1st district.

item.title: Dick Morris: DSA Wins Could Shift Democratic Caucus
item.description: Several Democratic Socialists of America-backed candidates could gain significant influence in a narrowly divided next Congress.

item.title: Hawaii Primary: Governor Leads, Progressive Challenges Incumbent
item.description: Hawaii's 1st District primary features Rep. Ed Case against Jarrett Keohokalole, who opposes Trump tariffs and ICE enforcement.
